node.title: Weighted incidence excludes rank nine from K'=20618 onward
node.closure: exact weighted boundary crossing after retracting a row-mixed common-core argument
node.statement: The fixed rank-nine affine-owner target is impossible for every 20618<=K'<=1048576. At K'=20618 the weighted demand 92397581841774591 exceeds the cap 92395178310909600 by 2403530864991; at K'=20617 the cap still wins by 7221289203362. The unrounded ratio is a product of ten increasing RS factors. The former low-row proof mixed an original-row 134944 common-core floor with residual support size after reverse shortening; that argument is retracted, and rank nine remains open on 10<=K'<=20617.
